value.rationale: Webster is a canonical divisor rule and quota is a central fairness axiom. The classical theorem that Webster is uniquely quota-safe for three entities makes the first four-entity failure a natural structural boundary. The theorem identifies that boundary exactly, classifies the entire violating chamber, and gives an exact neutral-simplex frequency and minimal integer witness.
